security_invariants: BUILTINS_ONLY is the default and invalid configuration fail-closed target; it rejects external bundles before scanning or reading their source
a signed manifest binds bundle kind, publisher, name, version, complete canonical inventory, SBOM and sandbox policy to a dedicated signer trust statement
caller-supplied kind and publisher must exactly match the signed identity and cannot relabel a SKILL as a PROVIDER or spoof a publisher
duplicate JSON keys, non-finite values, unknown manifest fields, path ambiguity, case collisions, traversal, symlinks, reparse points, special files and configured depth/count/size limits fail closed
verification and quarantine contain no dynamic import, exec, subprocess, package-manager or active-package overwrite path
physical quarantine is content-addressed, bounded, copied without following links, fsynced, reverified and atomically published under a per-digest cross-process owner
a source or signed-manifest switch between verification and quarantine is rejected before any durable catalog mutation
0060 records only digest, signer, SBOM, sandbox, state, fencing and audit references; raw bundle bytes, signatures and secrets are not database columns
the task-owned intake service stops at QUARANTINED or STAGED and never imports, activates or executes external Python
legacy Hub source install/search, raw custom-provider install and auto-repair reject before network, filesystem mutation, subprocess or package-manager execution
